metric_definitions.via_in_pad: summary via_in_pad: tools/kicad-oracle/via_in_pad.py's vias_in_pads on the routed board minus the input board's, floored at 0 (D8)
metric_definitions.below_minimum: summary below_minimum: routed tracks and vias (whose nanometre copper key the input board does not have) under the minimum track width, via diameter or via drill that KiCad's DRC checks (`oracle_lib.effective_minimums`, K15.44): Board Setup's value, replaced by the last unconditional .kicad_dru rule (no condition, no layer clause, not `severity ignore`) with a `min` for `track_width`, `via_diameter` or `hole_size`; summed. The summary also records board_minimums_mm, board_minimums_from and board_setup_minimums_mm
metric_definitions.manufacturing_breaches: summary manufacturing_breaches: the routing-caused KiCad DRC items (Q22.2's copper basis) of the types clearance, hole_clearance, hole_to_hole, copper_edge_clearance, track_width, via_diameter, annular_width, drill_out_of_range, solder_mask_bridge, shorting_items, summed
metric_definitions.kicad_unconnected: the signal: summary unconnected, kicad-cli's unconnected_items on the routed board after --refill-zones
metric_definitions.zone_zone_unconnected: secondary: the routed board's unconnected items (routed/drc.json, or the shared grade's) whose items are all zones: a pour split into islands that KiCad cannot join (K15.13's count)
metric_definitions.zone_zone_zones: the distinct (net, layer) zones those items name
metric_definitions.router_incomplete: the router's own incomplete connections at the end: the result manifest's board_statistics.connections.incomplete_count (work/<name>.result.json)
metric_definitions.kicad_less_router: secondary: kicad_unconnected - router_incomplete, how far KiCad's count is above the router's (K15.25 on pcu-76163c7: 36 off and 35 on; on canary-pwr-95882f00: 13 and 12)
metric_definitions.drc_real: guard (2): the sum of summary routing_caused_by_type (the grader's drc_real), every type
metric_definitions.route_seconds: guard (4): summary route_s, the routing call's wall-clock seconds
metric_definitions.connections: the result manifest's board_statistics.connections.maximum_count: the board's connections as the router loaded it, the default noise band's base
metric_definitions.input_unconnected: summary input_unconnected: kicad-cli's unconnected_items on the stripped input board
